title: Bidirectional DC-DC
source_docs: Powertrain Blockset/Energy Storage and Auxiliary Drive/DC-DC/Bidirectional_DC_DC.md
text: 支持双向升压和降压的 DC-to-DC 变换器；输出 3 路；按 {Parameterize losses by} 指定损耗计算 Single efficiency；{Converter response time constant, Tc} 指定常量 1/1000、{Converter response initial voltage, Vinit} 指定电压、{Converter power limit, Plimit} 指定功率、{Overall DC to DC converter efficiency, eff} 指定常量、{Vector of voltages (v) for tabulated loss, v_loss_bp} 指定断点、{Vector of currents (i) for tabulated loss, i_loss_bp} 指定断点、{Corresponding losses, losses_table} 指定二维查找表 N -by、{Vector of voltages (v) for tabulated efficiency, v_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Vector of currents (i) for tabulated efficiency, i_eff_bp} 指定断点、{Corresponding efficiency, efficiency_table} 指定二维查找表 N -by、{Calibrate Maps} 使用测量数据校准表 selection，按实例取值。

params.name: Parameterize losses by
params.values: 损耗计算 Single efficiency measurement (default) | Tabulated loss data | Tabulated efficiency data
